concept.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished concept sheet of THREE distinct portrait mobile game screens side by side, each screen a full 9:19 mobile layout, no phone hardware border. Audience 5-6 year old children. Original flat cheerful 2D cartoon art, clean rounded silhouettes, warm cream/mint/coral palette, attractive coherent actual game UI, large buttons, very little text. Left screen title 水果天平: a sturdy lovely physical wooden balance scale, suspended shallow pans, the left pan holds one large watermelon, right pan several little strawberries/apples; clearly different object sizes and weight, shelves with 6 fruit types, tiny pictorial equivalence clue, a pair of softly swaying pans, no animals on scale. Middle screen title 怪兽变声冒险: a charming mint-green fluffy round monster with two tiny horns and coral cheek spots running through a bright forest platform scene, stepping stones, a low tree branch, stars, a big minimal microphone bubble below and a visual high/low pitch ribbon, expressive illustrated character animation pose, large jump and duck pictograms. Right screen title 口令小冒险: same mint monster as a forest courier in a cozy illustrated top-down woodland grid playfield; simple clear paths around soft tree obstacles, monster carrying apple to cute bunny house, a clear key and door objective pictograms at top, small voice waveform bar below, compact collapsible touch-control icon, large rounded controls. Design screens that feel like real child-friendly mobile games, no paragraphs, no tutorial copy, no websites, no photorealism, no 3D, no labels except the three titles, no watermarks, no resemblance to licensed characters.

hero.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production animation sprite sheet for a cute original 2D flat preschool mobile game character. TRUE transparent background. EXACTLY twelve distinct sprites in a perfectly regular FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS grid, equal cells. All twelve show the SAME mint-green round furry little monster, two small warm-yellow horns, coral cheek spots, large black friendly eyes, small arms and short feet, facing RIGHT in 3/4 side view. Very clean flat vector-like filled shapes with only two color tones, crisp silhouette, no gradients, no texture, no 3D or realistic shading. Consistent proportions, same head, same scale, same color and ground baseline inside each cell; full body entirely contained in each cell, at least 10% transparent padding on all sides, no touching adjacent cells. The poses must be visibly different animation frames, not duplicated: row 1 left to right: running contact left foot forward; running body lowered passing step; running contact right foot forward; running airborne passing step. Row 2: jump upward arms raised legs extended; landing squash compressed body both feet wide; crouch low looking forward; crouch low blinking with head lowered. Row 3: hurt startled stumble leaning back; recovering wobble leaning forward; happy arms raised wide grin; happy celebratory little hop. No objects, no lettering, no frame numbers, no borders, no boxes, no ground shadows, no scenery, no watermark. Transparent areas between every sprite. This must be an actual usable twelve-frame animation atlas.

fruit.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite atlas for original flat colorful preschool puzzle game. EXACTLY SIX isolated fruit objects in a regular THREE COLUMNS TWO ROWS grid on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Top row left-to-right: one red strawberry with green leaves, one round orange tangerine with tiny leaf, one red apple with leaf. Bottom row left-to-right: one yellow-green pear, one squat orange pumpkin with green stem, one round green striped whole watermelon. Each fruit has the same front 3/4 simple viewpoint and a crisp friendly silhouette, realistic category but stylized for age 5; no faces, no arms. Pure clean flat shapes, two-tone cel colors, limited highlight, no gradient textures or 3D, warm coordinated palette and soft dark colored outline. Each fruit centered with at least 15 percent padding to its own equal square cell, fully separated, no overlapping. All isolated same-size sprite bounding box because the game will scale size by weight. No ground shadow, no stand, no basket, no text, no numbers, no cell lines, no watermark. Genuine clear alpha between fruit.

props.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production item atlas for an original flat preschool forest adventure. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. EXACTLY SIX isolated game props in a perfect THREE COLUMNS TWO ROWS grid, equal cells with 15 percent safe transparent padding. Top row left-to-right: chunky golden brass KEY, red APPLE with green leaf, five-point golden STAR. Bottom row left-to-right: a small warm wooden cottage doorway with a big closed teal DOOR and visible round knob, a cute WHITE BUNNY waiting by a little wooden rabbit house with carrot roof sign, a cozy woven BIRD NEST with two little pale eggs. Props recognizable at 40px screen size, bold simple silhouettes and soft dark colored outlines, same 3/4 front view, flat cheerful two-tone vector-like cartoon, mint/coral/honey/cream palette. Keep every prop self-contained, no scene, no shadows outside props, no glow, no lettering, no watermark, no cell borders. This will be used to animate carrying an apple, collecting a key, opening a door and delivering star to nest.

tree.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single production environment sprite for original flat preschool forest mobile game. One compact stylized tree with a broad rounded mint and sage green canopy, three simple leaf masses, little warm brown trunk visible at bottom, a tiny patch of grass only at its foot. 3/4 top-down view for a tile-based woodland path, crisp closed silhouette, flat two-tone vector-like filled shapes, no photographic texture, no complex shading, no realism, no 3D. Center it with 15 percent empty margin on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Fully isolated entire tree, no ground plane, no other objects, no text, no watermark, no drop shadow. Friendly, soft dark green contour, recognizable as a solid obstacle at 50px.
